rv.q: Every one of them fits this production like a cat in a sunbeam.
Music Theater Works has pulled out all the stops to offer a flawless and inspiring version of this musical.
Everything and everyone work perfectly together in this sensational and purr-fect production of CATS.
Music Theater Works’s Cats is, at its best, an excellent rendition of a maligned crowd-pleaser, and at its worst, a platform for a technology extremely destructive to the arts.
Under the clever direction/choreography of Mandy Modic, this marvelous story of felines and their personalities keeps the audience on its toes from start to finish.
This is a must-see for theater kids and dance students as well as anyone looking for an enjoyable, highly entertaining evening.
By leaning fully into its spectacle, humor, and eccentric charm, this production invites audiences to simply enjoy the Jellicle Ball, and rediscover the magic of live theatre.
Everything works together to create this world of CATS.

cn.t: Critics praise this production's show-stopping choreography, imaginative design, and energetic ensemble work, though the musical's plotless structure remains divisive. Most agree it's pure spectacle that successfully entertains.
